payload.blocks: Only phase 3 (the fold of p-mtqil2rpyy) of plan 261123-0726; phases 1 and 2 stay ready and run.
payload.headline: Backlog reconciliation is red for 278 reasons, not one: what should the folded original-id phase make true?

parts.cause: Measured 2026-11-23 on main: of 310 proposed items only one carries an Original id, and the item whose Original id is tsk-p7-shadow-binders (p-kqoljdbtbf) is done, not proposed. So counting Original ids alone clears none of the 278; the folded item's premise holds for identity-ids-unique, not for the red run.

options.cost: One phase, about 1 day; scripts and doc-health test only.
options.does: Phase 3 counts Original ids in both scripts through one reader, makes a section whose item is no longer proposed a named, fixable finding, keeps the line-scan cross-check and the loud addon failure; the 277 unreconciled items become a separate backlog row.
options.gain: No promise of the check is weakened; the fold lands as approved.
options.harm: Main stays red (277) until the separate row is done.
options.label: Fix ids, keep the rule, file the 277

options.cost: One phase, about 1 day, plus a note retiring the promise in the doc.
options.does: Same id work, and the check stops requiring a section for every proposed item: it asserts only that each section names a known item and carries its evidence.
options.gain: Main goes green in this plan.
options.harm: Drops the check's promise that a new proposed item fails until reconciled; that is a weakening under design principle 8 unless you retire the promise.
options.label: Narrow the check to the reconciled sections

options.cost: Several days of reading; a large doc change.
options.does: Add a phase that writes a verdict with evidence for each of the 277 items.
options.gain: Check green with its full promise.
options.harm: Turns a small fix plan into a large audit; delays phases 1 and 2's integration.
options.label: Reconcile all 277 in this plan

parts.recommendation: Fix ids, keep the rule, file the 277: it lands what you approved without weakening a check, and the 277-item audit is a different size of work that deserves its own row.

scope.allows: The planner writes phase 3 of plan 261123-0726 to the chosen option and sets the plan ready again; with option 1 it notes the 277 for the secretary to file.
scope.forbids: No code change by the planner, no edit to RECONCILIATION.md outside the phase, no change to phases 1 and 2.

parts.what: check-backlog-reconciliation.mjs reports 278 problems on main. 277 are proposed items with no section in RECONCILIATION.md (written in 2026-08 for 31 rows; 310 items are proposed now). The 278th is the section tsk-p7-shadow-binders.
